name: zillow-mcp
label: Zillow
description: Zillow listings, Zestimates and comparables, installed at runtime — no rebuild.
author: TheBananaStand

sends.purpose: The place you are asking about — a city, ZIP or street address — plus any price and bedroom filters. Addresses are listed as location and not just as a search phrase, because searching for a home says where you live or intend to. No conversation, file or account data is attached.
